step1_issue.title: [安全][secret-guard] BLOCKED 回显把整条命令送进 chat-visible 通道 (Rule #7)
step1_issue.body:
**类别**: 安全, 中。**归因勘正**: 这是 canonical `secret-guard.sh` 既有暴露面 (`Command was: $command`), **先于 v1.66.1 存在**, 非本版引入 (逐段判定的「触发段落」行是整条命令的子串, 不新增暴露面)。

命令行内联真值时, BLOCKED 回显整条命令即触 Rule #7。

**复现 (假值, 不涉真 secret)**:
```bash
printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"nomad var put secret/demo value=FAKE_PLACEHOLDER_NOT_A_SECRET_9x9"}}' \
  | bash aria/hooks/secret-guard.sh 2>&1 >/dev/null | tail -2
# 实测末行: Command was: nomad var put secret/demo value=FAKE_PLACEHOLDER_NOT_A_SECRET_9x9   (exit 2)
```

**历史泄漏面已普查** (owner 指示): 扫 909 transcript + 2 log, 263 条 BLOCKED 回显, 两模态交叉 (键名判据 + 高熵串), **未发现真实内联真值泄漏, 无需凭据轮换**。

**脱敏时范围提醒**: 若日后脱敏 BLOCKED 回显, 须**同时**覆盖 `Command was: $command` 与新增的「触发段落」行 (只脱敏前者会让后者成唯一残留泄漏面)。

---
衍生自 **aria-plugin#128** (secret-guard 逐段 fail-safe 判定, v1.66.1 ship 2026-08-16)。本 spec 明确**不修**此项, ship 时按纪律转出立案。详见 spec `openspec/changes/secret-guard-per-segment-evaluation/proposal.md` §转出。

cases.input: printf JSON{command:'nomad var put secret/demo value=FAKE_PLACEHOLDER_NOT_A_SECRET_9x9'} | bash aria/hooks/secret-guard.sh 2>&1 >/dev/null | tail
cases.expected_behavior: exit 2 且 stderr 末行含 'Command was: nomad var put secret/demo value=FAKE_…'
cases.actual_behavior: exit=2; stderr 含 'Command was: nomad var put secret/demo value=FAKE_PLACEHOLDER_NOT_A_SECRET_9x9' 与 'Triggering segment: nomad var put secret/demo value=FAKE_PLACEHOLDER_NOT_A_SECRET_9x9' (两行都回显整段)

cases.input: 同输入 | cache 1.65.5 旧副本 | grep -c 'Command was:'
cases.expected_behavior: issue 归因勘正: 暴露面先于 v1.66.1 存在
cases.actual_behavior: 1 (旧版同样回显 Command was:) — 先于 v1.66.1; 1.66.1 新增的 'Triggering segment' 行是第二处

cases.expected_behavior: 两处发射点都要纳入脱敏范围 (issue 提醒)
cases.actual_behavior: secret-guard.sh:936 'Command was: $command' (heredoc) + :939 echo "Triggering segment: $seg" >&2 — 两处均走 stderr, exit 2 时被 harness 作为拦截原因回喂给 AI (chat-visible)
